intro: This quest marks the final delivery of Nefarian's severed head to the leaders of Orgrimmar. Having proven the black dragon's demise to Thrall, champions are directed to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength to display the trophy before the entire Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Choose your reward so that I may mount the head of the beast for all to see.
